text: With cross-examination, where parties can query independent non-communicating copies of the debaters (for LLMs, by rerunning the model with earlier debate messages removed from context), Theorem 5.3 gives an (O(T log T), O(l log T), O(1))-debate protocol deterministically deciding any language decidable by an oracle machine in time T with queries of length l. In the protocol A outputs the whole transcript of M(x), B names the location of a supposed mistake, and V checks only that location.
title: Theorem 5.3: debate with cross-examination verifies time-T computations with O(1) queries
